title: Code and supplementary tables for the bovine HSTN L1MB1-associated intronic structural variant study
description: Scripts, tests and supplementary tables S1-S3 accompanying the manuscript on a sequence-level characterization of an L1MB1-associated intronic structural variant in bovine HSTN. All sequencing data are public (PRJEB78595, PRJEB63525, PRJNA905718); no raw reads are included.
